sample_unit: MedGPTs (custom medical GPTs, stratified sample from 6,233)

links.outcome: Factual accuracy and hallucination of web-deployed medical GPTs
links.effect: 25-30% of MedGPTs exhibit low factual accuracy, with bottom- and middle-tier models at highest risk; 33.6-54.3% violate operational thresholds.
links.quote: Our results show that 25-30% of MedGPTs exhibit low factual accuracy, with bottom- and middle-tier models at highest risk; 33.6-54.3% violate operational thresholds, and 57.06% of Action-enabled models lack adequate privacy disclosures.

links.outcome: Adequacy of privacy disclosures among Action-enabled MedGPTs
links.effect: 57.06% of Action-enabled models lack adequate privacy disclosures.

screen.reason: Empirical audit/benchmark of web-deployed medical GPTs assessing hallucination, safety, and policy compliance, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
